name: Geomagnetic Storm
body:
School evocation [electricity, light]; Level cleric/oracle 4, druid 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)

Area cylinder (40-ft. radius, 20-ft. high)

Duration 1 round/level

Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance yes

Dazzling multicolored lights taking on a multitude of unique shapes fill the area, though the illumination sheds only dim light in the area. Sparks of electricity continuously surge through the area, dealing 1d6 points of electricity damage + 1 point of electricity damage per two caster levels (maximum +10) to creatures and objects within the storm. The storm deals this damage when it appears, and to all creatures in the area on your turn each round. The magnetism created by the storm is too weak to affect most metallic objects, but any ranged attack made with small metallic projectiles including arrows, bolts, and bullets passing through the storm suffers a 50% miss chance.
